simple.meaning: to be pungent ; i.e. in taste ( sour , i.e. literally fermented , or figuratively, harsh ), in color ( dazzling )

definitions.short: to be pungent ; i.e. in taste ( sour , i.e. literally fermented , or figuratively, harsh ), in color ( dazzling )
definitions.full: H2556. chamets I. חָמֵץ verb be sour, leavened (Late Hebrew id. , Pi`el Hiph`il make sour, leaven ; Arabic be sour ; Aramaic חֲמַע be sour, leavened , be leavened ) — Qal Perfect חָמֵץ Exod 12:39 ; Imperfect יֶחְמָ֑ץ 12:34 ; Infinitive suffix חֻמְצָתוֺ Hosea 7:4 +; — be leavened , of dough ( בָּצֵק ), Exod 12:34 , 39 (E), compare Hosea 7:4 . Hitph. be soured, embittered , Psa 73:21 (|| אֶשְׁתּוֺנָן כִּלְיוֺתַי ). II. [ חמץ ] verb be red (? compare Aramaic Ethpa`al blush, be ashamed , possibly originally be red ); — Qal Passive participle construct בְּגָדִים חֲמוּץ red of garments Isa 63:1 ; possibly also Imperfect 3feminine singular תֶּחֱמַץ Psa 68:24 that thy foot may be red with blood (for תמחץ ᵑ0 ; so Krochm Hi Gr; most, however, read תרחץ see רחץ ). III. [ חמץ ] verb be ruthless (dubious √; perhaps by-form of חמס ; perhaps erroneous for it; identification by most with I. חמץ , be sour , hence sharp, violent , but connection improbable) — only Qal Participle active וְחוֺמֵץ מְעַוֵּל מִכַּף Psa 71:4 from the hand of the unjust and ruthless (|| רָשָׁע מִיַּד ).
